critical_red_flags: Chest pain, pressure, or tightness (বুকে ব্যথা বা চাপ)
Sudden slurred speech, facial droop, or one-sided weakness (কথা জড়িয়ে যাওয়া বা শরীরের এক পাশ অবশ লাগা)
Sudden severe headache or loss of consciousness
routine_indicators: Standing up too quickly, heat exposure, missed meals, mild dehydration without vomiting
dizziness_vertigo.decision_flip_rule: If cardiac or neurological red flags (chest pain, stroke signs, fainting) are unverified, DO NOT reassure. Prioritize verifying them immediately.

critical_red_flags: Uncontrolled spurting blood or bleeding that does not stop after 5 minutes of firm pressure
Burns covering the face, airway, hands, or larger than the patient's palm
Charred/white painless skin indicating third-degree burn
routine_indicators: Superficial redness, minor localized scrape with controlled oozing
burns_wounds.decision_flip_rule: Verify airway involvement (for facial burns) and bleeding control before routing to a local pharmacy.

critical_red_flags: Pain radiating to left arm, jaw, or back with sweating
Inability to speak full sentences due to breathlessness
routine_indicators: Mild cough with clear nasal congestion and normal breathing at rest
chest_breathing.decision_flip_rule: Any acute chest pain or inability to speak full sentences immediately flips to Severe.
